02 · Colour Breakdown

Inside the Grade

Naveen's signature format on Instagram is the Colour Breakdown — showing exactly how a shot is built, node by node. This is that suite, alive: spinning wheels, a dancing waveform, scopes that never sit still.

SHADOWSMIDTONESHIGHLIGHTS

LIVE WAVEFORM — PARADE RGB

Every decision is scoped, not guessed: exposure on the waveform, skin tones on the vectorscope, balance on the parade. That's the difference between a filter and a grade.

01

Balance & Exposure

LOG is normalised first — white balance, exposure and contrast set the honest foundation before any look is applied.

02

Skin & Separation

Skin tones are protected and qualified, then separated from backgrounds so faces always lead the frame.

03

The Look

Colour wheels shape the mood — teal shadows, warm highlights, halation and grain for a true film finish.

04

Shot Matching & Delivery

Every shot is matched across the timeline, then delivered for cinema, broadcast, OTT or social — in the right colour space, every time.

03 · About & Services

Filmmaker first.
Colourist by obsession.

Naveen (@coloristnav) is a filmmaker and Senior Colorist at Figureout Post. His work spans Tamil music videos, national brand commercials and an Irish feature screened in Dublin — and he works remotely with directors, DOPs and production houses worldwide. He also teaches the craft at Master Color Academy — “Learn to Grade Like a Pro” in DaVinci Resolve.

🎞️ Feature & Music Video Grading

Full-length narrative and music video grades — look development, shot matching and a film finish built with the director and DOP.

✨ Commercials & Brand Films

Premium, broadcast-safe colour for brands and agencies — product-true colour, flawless skin, fast turnarounds for campaigns.

🌍 Remote Grading — Worldwide

Send footage from anywhere. Calibrated remote workflow with review links and live sessions, delivered in your required colour space.
